associations.rationale: The displayed type gives an A-linear equivalence from End_k(V) to finrank-indexed copies of V, but its evaluation behavior is hidden and it does not itself state the full finite-basis evaluation claim.
The displayed type gives an A-linear equivalence from End_k(V) to basis-indexed vectors, but it does not display that the map sends x to (x v_i)_i or state the finite-dimensional nV consequence.

The displayed equality identifies each component of the basis-indexed equivalence with evaluation on that basis vector, but it does not itself assert that evaluation is an isomorphism or the nV consequence.

The displayed equality identifies the canonical finite-basis components with evaluation, but it is only the application formula and does not itself state the linear isomorphism and its n-copy consequence.
